notes.title: My new game is OUT! Automation, Colony Building, Defense
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2349040/Dinky_Guardians/
[previewyoutube=dVbU7jO67A8;full][/previewyoutube]
⬆️ Clone your first 🐷Dinky, give them 👉orders to help you, Research 🦾Automation Machines, Defend your Colony from the 👿Zumbys, Build a 🚀Rocket, colonize other 🌍Planets and set up supply chains between them! Play Solo👤 or Co-op👥 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43477750/d49245dbc460be2c1e93bb3df2daf20700599fb8.gif

The Ultimate Goal
Repopulate the entire galaxy with Dinkys and fully automate everything with Machines so that the Dinkys can live their lives in peace!


Play solo or with up to 4 friends in this fun Colony-Building, Automation, Defense adventure

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2349040/Dinky_Guardians/


Interested in the behind the scenes? Watch my devlogs to see how the game came to be!
https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLzDRvYVwl53ueGEHkpRtO9e-7QZDHNcfa


Thanks and I hope you like the game!
- Hugo (Code Monkey, Endless Loop Studios)

notes.title: My next game, Total World Liberation, wishlist now!
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2177230/Total_World_Liberation/
[previewyoutube=08N85yARCMo;full][/previewyoutube]

They have taken over everything, it's up to you to LIBERATE the entire world!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32978864/4799d3bd407cd877caa1969ba0b1351fd3a0482d.gif

* Find other Survivors and bring them with you.
* Build your base with a Workshop, Generator, Houses and plenty of Defenses and Traps!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32978864/dd7cbbeb3af23274fd65c6ead45e5f4904cf3f8b.gif

* Split up into multiple teams and explore different areas, don't forget to bring enough ammo when you leave your base!
* Set up outposts to gather resources in far away lands and Transport them back to your base through Automated machines, ensure the Zombies don't destroy your logistics!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32978864/c0c59f2340ef79f735d54daf64ea3e2d6674133c.gif

* Craft items, armor, weapons and lots of ammo, build Drones to help you Gather, Craft and Patrol
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32978864/0603411db532e715ad234a9baeffaba910f22074.gif

* Explore a large persistent open world, with no loading or mission instances, everything happens in the world.
* Turn-Based so you can take your time to think and come up with the perfect Strategy
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32978864/a141b0ffa70b7acb86963690902db36a487761f9.gif

* Ambush Zombies and take them all out without suffering casualties
* Be careful when exploring at night, and be even more careful so you don't attract a massive horde!

Start just with one Survivor and Liberate the entire World!


Add to your Wishlist now! Q3 2023
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32978864/877249ba8ddffa0abe2dc4dca3ce1b5496e8c6a2.gif

And follow the Development on YouTube @CodeMonkeyUnity



Interested in the behind the scenes? Watch this video!
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6DGDWfPdn3w

Thanks for watching!
- Hugo (Code Monkey, Endless Loop Studios)
